description: This file defines a React context provider ('ProgressProvider') and a hook ('useProgress') for managing and persisting user progress state in a language learning frontend application. It handles local storage synchronization and provides methods to update progress, such as marking lessons as completed.

methods.name: ProgressProvider
methods.description: A React component that provides progress state and actions to its children, with persistence to local storage.

methods.name: useProgress
methods.description: A custom React hook to access progress context values and methods.
